{"implementation": "def solve(case):
    edges = case['edges']
    init_communities = case['communities']
    resolution = case.get('resolution', 1.0)
    
    adj = {}
    deg = {}
    total_weight = 0.0
    for u, v, w in edges:
        total_weight += w
        adj.setdefault(u, {})
        adj.setdefault(v, {})
        adj[u][v] = adj[u].get(v, 0) + w
        adj[v][u] = adj[v].get(u, 0) + w
        deg[u] = deg.get(u, 0) + w
        deg[v] = deg.get(v, 0) + w
    
    for node in init_communities:
        adj.setdefault(node, {})
        deg.setdefault(node, 0)
    
    labels = dict(init_communities)
    comm_deg = {}
    for node, comm in labels.items():
        comm_deg[comm] = comm_deg.get(comm, 0) + deg[node]
    
    nodes = sorted(adj.keys())
    move_ledger = []
    
    changed = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        for node in nodes:
            current_comm = labels[node]
            k_i = deg[node]
            w_to_comm = {}
            for neighbor, w in adj[node].items():
                neighbor_comm = labels[neighbor]
                w_to_comm[neighbor_comm] = w_to_comm.get(neighbor_comm, 0) + w
            if current_comm not in w_to_comm:
                w_to_comm[current_comm] = 0.0
            
            best_gain = 0.0
            best_comm = current_comm
            w_current = w_to_comm[current_comm]
            K_current = comm_deg.get(current_comm, 0)
            for comm, w_to in w_to_comm.items():
                delta_w = w_to - w_current
                delta_K = comm_deg.get(comm, 0) - K_current
                gain = delta_w - resolution * (k_i * delta_K) / (2 * total_weight)
                if gain > best_gain:
                    best_gain = gain
                    best_comm = comm
                elif gain == best_gain and comm < best_comm:
                    best_comm = comm
            
            if best_comm != current_comm:
                old_comm = current_comm
                new_comm = best_comm
                comm_deg[old_comm] -= k_i
                comm_deg[new_comm] = comm_deg.get(new_comm, 0) + k_i
                labels[node] = new_comm
                move_ledger.append([node, old_comm, new_comm])
                changed = True
    
    return {'labels': labels, 'moves': move_ledger}"}
